canonical_project: Bitterfeld Blue Future Technologiegebiet hyperscale data center, Marke/Raguhn-Jessnitz
owner: FAB Gesellschaft fuer Gebietsentwicklung und Infrastrukturdienstleistungen
notes: Golem, citing Mitteldeutsche Zeitung and local council activity, reported a hyperscale data center planned by 2030 near Marke, part of Raguhn-Jessnitz, on roughly 60 hectares with about 150 jobs; local councils were reconsidering or opposing the plan. Capacity not disclosed.
